title: Pre-K Open Studio
seo_title: Pre-K Open Studio in Springfield, MO – Nov 13
description: Pre-K Open Studio is a free arts event on Friday, November 13, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at Fairbanks Community Hub, 1126 North Broadway in Springfield, MO. It is a family-friendly option for anyone looking for a creative morning out.
